missing_points: Verify parameter P00.20 (Master Frequency Command Source) is set to the correct input source (0=Digital keypad, 1=RS-485 communication, 2=External analog input)
Check that the speed reference input (analog or digital terminal) is actually changing and is wired correctly per the manual's wiring diagram
If using terminal inputs, verify the terminal block connector is fully seated and the input signal is present with a voltmeter
Review the Speed Reference Control chart to ensure the correct parameter settings for the input source in use
